page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs backed by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The platform is paired with 256.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Network capabilities include a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth to support multi-node communication.

This server instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for operating system installation and persistent data hosting. The absence of integrated local disks concentrates resource allocation on core compute density and RAM, optimizing costs for architectures that rely primarily on centralized block or object storage solutions.

Given its high core count and memory capacity, ecs.g5.16xlarge is well suited for enterprise backend applications, mid-to-large relational database nodes, in-memory caching layers, build server fleets, and general container orchestration clusters requiring significant compute concurrency.
